'''Guillermo Ruiz''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 17 from Barcelona, Spain; Red 42 from Barcelona, Sp. The published fan table records status: Now Red 42.

== Squadron listing ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Slot !! Town !! Status (fan table)
|-
| Gold 17 || Barcelona, Spain || Now Red 42
|-
| Red 42 || Barcelona, Sp || Retired
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
